objective: Propose a task-sized indie studio for a bounded single-player PC game using an established engine.
assumptions: No custom engine, online service or simultaneous console launch
A twelve-month human planning reference, not an AI speed estimate
Seven core positions with scoped specialist help; actual staffing depends on content volume and evidence

project_lead.title: Producer / game direction
functions: Define product scope, audience, priorities and milestone decisions
Coordinate actual playtests and early release positioning
Integrate accepted team deliveries against owner requirements

exit_criteria: An actual prototype tests the core loop with intended players
Major technical and scope risks have observed findings
One representative section is playable with representative visual and audio targets
Observed content-production throughput supports a revised remaining scope
The bounded content plan is playable end to end
Cross-discipline interfaces and remaining defects have accountable owners
Release-critical behavior, compatibility and performance are checked on target builds
Real playtest findings are addressed or explicitly accepted by the owner
The release candidate meets the agreed technical and product criteria
The owner authorizes external publication and post-release support has a plan
